clue.text: Declining ten years with National Trust

parts.note: a decade is a period of ten years
NT is the usual abbreviation for the National Trust, the British heritage charity

explanation.surface: A report on falling numbers over a decade at the heritage charity.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in moral or cultural decline is described with this adjective, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Coiled around and submissive

indicators.note: around here means the letters of the word coiled are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A snake lying wound up and meek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' signals the anagram: the letters of COILED are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A submissive creature is meek and easily led, which is the plain synonym here.

clue.text: Dour, cold safe

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
something safe does no damage, harmless

explanation.surface: A terse description of a gloomy, chilly strongbox.
explanation.definitionFit: A dour, sullen person lacks any appeal or warmth, so is without attraction.

clue.text: Hamlet, say, heard to condescend

indicators.note: heard means the word for a native of Denmark is spoken, giving letters that sound the same

parts.note: Hamlet is the Prince of Denmark, an example of a Dane

explanation.surface: The Danish prince, overheard, stooping to speak to others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks Hamlet as an example: he is a Dane, and 'heard' says that word is spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: To stoop to do something beneath one's dignity is the exact meaning of both words.

clue.text: Spotted heavyweight rising, getting killed

indicators.note: getting joins the two pieces, the first one acquiring the second
in a down clue, rising means the word for a large weight is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a ton is a very heavy weight
iced is slang for killed, murdered

explanation.surface: A big boxer seen getting up only to be finished off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns TON upward into NOT; ICED is underworld slang for killed.
explanation.definitionFit: Having been spotted means having been seen or observed, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Help idiot first

parts.note: an ass is a fool
1ST, written with letters as IST, is the abbreviation for first

explanation.surface: A plea for aid with the fool going ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: The ordinal 1st is read with the digit as the letter I, giving IST.
explanation.definitionFit: To aid someone is to give them a hand, the plain verb synonym.

clue.text: Persevere as small, ancient metal boxes start to explode

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
ancient means old

indicators.note: boxes means the metal surrounds the next piece, enclosing it

parts.note: iron is a metal

indicators.note: start to means only the opening letter of the following word is used

explanation.surface: Old metal containers are about to go off, tiny ones at that.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxes' looks like a noun for containers, but it is the verb: the metal encloses the opening letter of 'explode', making IERON.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going doggedly in spite of difficulty is to carry on, as a determined soldier would.

clue.text: Children matter

definitions.meaning: offspring, a formal word for a person's descendants
a topic or subject under discussion

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both one's offspring in legal language and a point under debate.

clue.text: Suppress article about rubbish tribunal lacking guts

indicators.note: about means the article goes round what follows, enclosing it

parts.note: the is the definite article
rot is nonsense, rubbish

indicators.note: lacking guts means the inside letters of the word are removed, leaving only its ends

explanation.surface: Silencing a cowardly court with an article dismissing it as nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking guts' empties the tribunal of its middle, and 'about' makes the article wrap everything else, giving THROTTLE once the E closes it.
explanation.definitionFit: To choke off or stifle something is to suppress it, here figuratively.

clue.text: Talks about endless debauchery in carriages

indicators.note: about means the talks go round the next piece

parts.note: chats are informal talks

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word for revelry is dropped

parts.note: a riot is wild, unrestrained revelry

explanation.surface: Gossip about a never-ending orgy in horse-drawn coaches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' drops the last letter of the revelry word, and 'about' has the talks go round what is left; 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: These two-wheeled horse-drawn vehicles of antiquity are a kind of carriage.

clue.text: Constant runner-up is more compact

parts.note: C is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light
the runner-up is the loser of a final

explanation.surface: A sports remark about someone who always comes second being tighter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something packed more tightly or denser is described with this comparative.

clue.text: Responsibility with respect to America

parts.note: on means concerning, as in a book on birds
US is the United States

explanation.surface: A diplomatic note about duty regarding the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A burden or obligation that falls on someone is their duty.

clue.text: Yellow object that doesn't work

definitions.meaning: a dud product, especially a faulty car

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a pale citrus colour and also slang for a dud purchase such as a faulty car.

clue.text: Bold prisoner able to conceal hideaway

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner

indicators.note: to conceal means the word for capable hides the next piece inside it

parts.note: fit means capable, able
a den is a private retreat

explanation.surface: A daring inmate capable of hiding a secret lair.
explanation.definitionFit: A bold person is self-assured and sure of themselves, the sense here.

clue.text: Honour about to go to hospital division

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a ward is a division of a hospital

explanation.surface: An award is about to go to a hospital department.
explanation.definitionFit: An honour is bestowed in recognition, so a prize or recompense fits as a synonym.

clue.text: Cut off a story by upcoming beat journalist

parts.note: a story is a fib, a lie

indicators.note: in a down clue, upcoming means the word for thrash is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to tan is to beat, thrash
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter isolated by a tale about a coming beat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upcoming' turns TAN into NAT; 'beat' looks like a journalist's patch but is the verb thrash.
explanation.definitionFit: Being estranged or isolated from others is a figurative cutting off.

clue.text: Bizarre posh and expensive car covered in cork

indicators.note: covered in means the pieces go inside the stopper word

parts.note: a cork is a seal on a bottle
U means upper-class, posh
RR is Rolls-Royce, a famously expensive car

explanation.surface: An odd image of a luxury car wrapped in cork.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dreamlike and strange is weird, which matches bizarre closely.

clue.text: Organ stained and set aside

parts.note: the ear is an organ of hearing
marked means stained, blemished

explanation.surface: A body part that is soiled and put to one side.
explanation.definitionFit: Funds or items reserved for a purpose are designated, put by for later.

clue.text: Notice present by new Tesla advocate

parts.note: an ad is a notice, an advertisement
here means present, in attendance
T is the symbol for the tesla, the unit of magnetic flux density

explanation.surface: An advert for a new electric car aimed at its fan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tesla' suggests the car maker, but here it is the scientific unit with symbol T.
explanation.definitionFit: A supporter or follower of a cause is its champion, its advocate.

clue.text: Stylish ring with wood inlaid

indicators.note: inlaid means the wood is set into the ringing sound

parts.note: ding is the sound of a bell ringing
ash is a wood

explanation.surface: A fashionable ring with timber inlay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' seems to be jewellery, but it is the noise a bell makes.
explanation.definitionFit: A dashing figure is smart and elegant, cutting a fine figure in style.

clue.text: Facile nonsense shortly rejected

indicators.note: rejected means the shortened word is sent back, read in reverse
shortly means the word for rubbish loses its final letter

parts.note: bilge is rubbish, nonsense

explanation.surface: Superficial rubbish quickly dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' cuts BILGE to BILG; 'rejected' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: A facile remark is shallow and slick, said with too much ease and little thought.

clue.text: Pot to go in larder

parts.note: a pan is a cooking pot
a go is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: Putting a cooking pot away in the food store.
explanation.definitionFit: A larder is a room or cupboard for storing food, the same as this one.

clue.text: Introduction of European mug following press release

indicators.note: following means the later pieces come after the first one

parts.note: PR, public relations, is the business of press releases
mug is slang for face

explanation.surface: A publicity statement introducing a European's face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mug' looks like a cup but is slang for a face.
explanation.definitionFit: The opening section of a book that introduces it to the reader is its foreword.

clue.text: Tries electronic vehicle

parts.note: a judge hears a case, tries it in court
E is the abbreviation for electronic, as in e-mail

explanation.surface: Testing out an electric car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tries' means attempts on the surface but is the legal sense of trying a case.
explanation.definitionFit: The car that carries a coffin to a funeral is a specific kind of vehicle.

clue.text: Dear former lover deep in thought

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
pensive means deep in thought, reflective

explanation.surface: Addressing an old flame who is lost in reflection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dear' looks like a letter's opening, but means costly.
explanation.definitionFit: Dear in the sense of costly, high-priced, is a standard synonym.

clue.text: Parking vehicle gives sense of achievement

parts.note: P is the sign for parking
a ride is something you travel in, a vehicle

explanation.surface: Finding a parking space for one's car brings satisfaction.
explanation.definitionFit: Satisfaction in one's accomplishments is a feeling of self-respect, the noun here.

clue.text: Part of girdle a seamstress let out

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A seamstress enlarging a tight girdle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let out' looks like a seamstress's alteration, but here it means rent out.
explanation.definitionFit: To rent property to a tenant is to let it out under contract.

clue.text: Mammal taking bird in both hands

indicators.note: taking means the two hand letters take the bird between them

parts.note: L and R are left and right, both hands
the emu is a flightless bird

explanation.surface: An animal holding a bird in its two paws.
explanation.definitionFit: This Madagascan primate is a kind of mammal.

clue.text: Departs having taken last of cats' lives

indicators.note: having taken means the departing word takes the next letter inside it

parts.note: exits means departs, leaves

indicators.note: last of means only the final letter of the following word is used

explanation.surface: A cat leaves after using up its nine lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lives' looks like a plural noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To be alive is to have being, the verb sense of existing.

clue.text: Grass brand right for blow

parts.note: hay is dried grass
a make is a brand of product

explanation.surface: A lawn-care brand chosen for its ability to hit hard.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild swinging punch is a blow, especially in boxing slang.

clue.text: Time tears apart fashions

parts.note: rends means tears apart

explanation.surface: Time ripping up the latest styles.
explanation.definitionFit: Current styles or vogues are the plural noun meaning fashions.

clue.text: Resent worker consuming fantastic drug by gram

indicators.note: consuming means the worker swallows the next pieces inside it

parts.note: a worker bee

indicators.note: fantastic means the letters of drug are rearranged wildly

explanation.surface: An employee bitter about someone taking a wonderful drug by the gram.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fantastic' rearranges DRUG into GRUD; 'worker' is the crossword's bee.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel grudging envy towards someone's good fortune is to resent it.
